title: 第290章 百家论道万道争鸣第289章 清静无为抱元守一
slug: 别人修仙我闲逛游历三界终长生
content_zh:
玉霄真人论道一炷香。
一炷香之后，他停下讲道，中台周围的道光也渐渐消散。
玉霄真人睁开眼，神色淡然，面带微笑道：
“贫道浅见，聊叙本心，抛砖引玉，以待百家争鸣，万道齐放。”
“接下来，还请诸位仙友论道。”
说罢，他便微微躬身，缓步走下中台，将论道高台给予九州各道仙友。
全场静默片刻，随即响起阵阵由衷的赞叹与钦佩之声。
“不愧是崆峒山的掌门啊！”
“深得广成祖师的道韵，道心通透，境界超然！”
“是极是极！”
“原来清静无为从不是消极避世，是守本心、顺天道。”
“今日一听玉霄真人讲道，真是茅塞顿开啊！”
“上古真意流转至今，万载道统不绝，崆峒山果真名不虚传啊！”
......
接下来，九州百宗，各路仙友，纷纷登台讲道。
有道门正统长老登台，详论正法传承、戒律本心，道韵森严，法理端正。
有散修真人登台，畅谈野修之道，随性悟道、自然证法，洒脱自在，别出机杼。
有佛门高僧登台，以禅意解大道，以慈悲释修行，空明澄澈，引人深思。
更有年少天才弟子登台，论本心新悟，谈少年新道，朝气蓬勃，新意十足。
一时间，八台齐鸣，百道争辉。

整座玄鹤峰道音袅袅，法理潺潺。
无数修行之人坐于各台之前，凝神倾听，取长补短，感悟不同道途的真谛，吸纳百家修行的精髓。
九州仙道盛会，百家论道，万道争鸣，盛况空前。
诸多宗门之中，近日风头最盛、最受各方仙友关注的，便是纪风身旁的灵剑山。
苍恒真人千年未能飞升，忽然一朝功成，悄然飞升。
打破了几十年九州仙门未有人飞升的沉寂，堪称近年来凡间各道仙门的第一盛事。
灵剑山之名，一夜之间响彻九州，无人不知，无人不晓。
此刻仙道盛会百家论道，各方仙友目光频频投向灵剑山一众落座之地，眼神之中满是期待与好奇。
“灵剑山苍恒真人一朝飞升，证得无上大道，门中必然底蕴深厚，天才辈出！”
“恳请灵剑山前辈登台论道，让我等后辈晚辈，一睹飞升宗门道统风采！”
“愿闻灵剑山大道真意，共悟飞升机缘法理！”
content_en:
Master Yuxiao discussed the Tao with a stick of incense.
After burning the incense, he stopped preaching, and the light around the center gradually dissipated.
Master Yuxiao opened his eyes, looked calm and said with a smile:
"I have a humble opinion, talk about my true feelings, throw out some ideas, and wait for a hundred schools of thought to contend, and all schools of thought to flourish."
"Next, I'd like to invite you fellow immortals to discuss the Tao."
After saying that, he bowed slightly, walked slowly down the middle platform, and gave the high platform for discussion to all the immortals in Kyushu.
The audience was silent for a moment, and then there were bursts of heartfelt praise and admiration.
"As expected of the leader of Kongtong Mountain!"
"I have learned deeply from Patriarch Guangcheng's Taoism, my Taoist heart is clear, and my realm is transcendent!"
"Yes, yes!"
"It turns out that being quiet and doing nothing is not about passively avoiding the world, but about keeping one's heart and obeying the way of nature."
“When I heard Master Yuxiao’s sermon today, I was really enlightened!”
"The true meaning of ancient times has been passed down to this day, and the Taoism has been unbroken for thousands of years. Kongtong Mountain really deserves its reputation!"
...
Next, hundreds of sects in Kyushu and immortal friends from all walks of life took the stage to preach.
An orthodox Taoist elder came on stage and discussed in detail the inheritance of the righteous Dharma and the original intention of the precepts. The Taoist rhyme was strict and the legal principles were upright.
There is a real person who is a practicing cultivator on the stage, talking freely about the way of cultivating in the wild, enlightening the Tao casually, realizing the Dharma naturally, free and easy, and not following the rules.
An eminent Buddhist monk came on the stage to explain the Tao with Zen and practice with compassion. The sky was clear and clear, making people think deeply.
There are also young talented disciples who take the stage to talk about the new enlightenment of the original heart and the new way of young people. They are full of vitality and new ideas.
For a time, eight stations were singing in unison, and a hundred channels were competing for glory.
The whole Xuanhe Peak is filled with the sound of Taoism and the gurgling of Dharma principles.
Countless practitioners sat in front of each stage, listening attentively, learning from each other's strengths, comprehending the true meaning of different paths, and absorbing the essence of hundreds of schools of practice.
The Kyushu Immortal Dao Festival is an unprecedented event, with hundreds of schools of thought discussing Taoism and thousands of Taoisms contending.
Among the many sects, the one that has attracted the most attention recently and attracted the most attention from immortal friends from all walks of life is Lingjian Mountain next to Ji Feng.
Master Cang Heng had not been able to ascend for thousands of years, but suddenly he succeeded and quietly ascended.
Breaking the decades of silence in which no one from the Kyushu Immortal Sect has ascended, it can be called the number one event among all the Immortal Sects in the mortal world in recent years.
The name of Lingjian Mountain resounded throughout Jiuzhou overnight, and no one knew about it.
At this moment, hundreds of schools of thought were discussing the Immortal Way at the grand gathering. Immortal friends from all walks of life frequently cast their eyes towards the place where everyone was sitting in Lingjian Mountain, their eyes full of expectation and curiosity.
"Once Master Cang Heng of Lingjian Mountain ascends to the throne and attains the supreme path, his sect will surely have profound knowledge and many geniuses will emerge!"
"I sincerely request the seniors of Lingjian Mountain to come on stage to discuss Taoism, so that I, the younger generation, and the younger generation can have a glimpse of the Taoism of the Ascension Sect!"
"I would like to hear the true meaning of the great road of Lingjian Mountain and understand the principles of ascension together!"
